verdict.rationale: Foreloop's feedback pipeline uses an AI agent to triage raw submissions, dismiss spam/noise, and auto-fill an intention with proposed tasks — showing some decluttering and opportunity-surfacing behavior. However, there's no evidence of explicit prioritization/impact-ranking of feedback (the scoring/P0-P2 system is scoped to PR code reviews, not feedback triage), and no aggregation view for spotting top opportunities across many submissions. Missing for 10: impact-scoring or ranking of feedback opportunities, aggregation/dedup across submissions, independent validation of triage quality.
